Name: Cheating Snack
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Warning: This mod is ridiculously overpowered and unapologetically cheats.[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]I added some wonderful buffs to the field snack, and now it grants a bonus to Farming, Luck, Fishing, and Foraging, and it even gives you a little extra energy to work hard on the farm all day long.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]Yes, the buff lasts all day![/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Taste the power of pure cheating.[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]I also left Joja Cola as a combat tonic, don't forget to buy yours when you go exploring the caves![/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Eat. Cheat. Repeat.[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]

[b]2.[/b] 📦 Drop the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. 
[b]3.[/b] 🧠 Extract it there like a civilized human being. 
[b]4. [/b]🚀 Launch the game using SMAPI. 
[b]5. [/b]🎉 Enjoy your new social life![/color]

[b]2.[/b] 💔 Go back to Nexus Mods and tell me why you left me (optional, but emotionally impactful). 
[b]3.[/b] 😢 I’ll pretend I’m fine. 
[b]4. [/b]🌾 Go enjoy Stardew Valley without me… I guess.[/color]

[color=#ffffff]1.❗ Delete the old version (yes, really—don’t be lazy).
2. 📥 Install the new version following the steps above.[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]⚠️ Important:[/b]
 Do [b]NOT[/b] overwrite files. That’s how chaos begins 💀
 Delete first, then install the update like a responsible adult.[/color]
